svg.title: autofwd: automatic port forwarding in herdr

g.text: Your server, saved as a machine in herdr. Nothing is forwarded yet: ⇄ no ports
Start anything that listens: it's on your computer's localhost:8000 a moment later (⇄ 8000)
ctrl+b f opens the Ports panel: every forward, on every machine
! gpu-box 8000: localhost:8000 is used by the forward from dev-server (8000)
gpu-box wants port 8000 too: it gets 8001, and the panel says why
Detected: a new remote host or port stops it and adds yours.
! localhost:8000 is already used by the forward from dev-server
! gpu-box 8000: localhost:8000 is used by the forward from dev-server (8000)
Edit it (e): a taken port is refused with who has it. Nothing breaks
Pick a free one and it moves: localhost:8080
+ adds a forward: any port, or any host:port the server can reach
Done: the server's port 9000 is on localhost:9000
